items.title: Welcome channel
items.description: Where Blitz greets new members. Leave empty for no welcome messages.

items.title: Level-up channel
items.description: Where level-ups are announced. Leave empty to announce them where they happened.

items.title: Quote wall
items.description: Messages that get enough 🗣️ reactions are saved here. Leave empty to turn the quote wall off.

items.title: Birthday channel
items.description: Where Blitz wishes people happy birthday. Leave empty to turn birthdays off.

items.title: Suggestions channel
items.description: Where !suggest posts ideas for everyone to vote on. Leave empty to turn suggestions off.

items.title: Staff log
items.description: Where Blitz notes reports, moderation, shield catches, auto-mod removals, inbox transcripts, joins and leaves, for the team. Leave empty for no staff log.

items.title: Message log
items.description: Where Blitz notes edited and deleted messages, with what they said. Leave empty to turn it off.

items.title: Private channels
items.description: Blitz stays out of these: no XP, no quotes, never shown in its domain or sent to its brain. Good for vent or staff channels.

items.title: Role for new members
items.description: Given to everyone who joins. Leave empty to give none.

items.title: Birthday role
items.description: Worn for the day on someone's birthday. Leave empty to give none.

items.title: Roles people can pick
items.description: Roles members can give themselves with !role (pronouns, games, ping roles…). Blitz's role must be above them.

items.title: Staff
items.description: Can use staff commands like !clear, !announce and !setxp. The owner, and roles that can manage the community, kick or ban, always can.

items.title: Welcome message
items.description: Your own welcome for new members. {user} pings them, {name} is their name, {community} the community's name and {members} the member count. Leave empty for Blitz's own greetings.

items.title: Turn off levels
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz handing out XP and level-ups. Levels are on while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off Stardust
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz handing out Stardust (earned by chatting and daily visits, spent on looks for your own Blitz in its domain). On while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off the inbox
items.description: Tick to stop members opening private conversations with the team (questions, reports and appeals) through Blitz. On while this is unticked.

items.title: Reactions for the quote wall
items.description: How many 🗣️ reactions (not counting the author's) save a message to the quote wall.

items.title: Turn off domain links
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz adding a link to its domain under its replies to commands (and spinning in the domain when someone uses one). On while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off auto-mod
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz removing floods, copy-paste spam, mass mentions, glitchy text and blocked words. Auto-mod is on while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off cool-offs
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz muting someone for 10 minutes after auto-mod removes 3 of their messages in 10 minutes (it'll just alert the staff log instead). On while this is unticked.

items.title: Block invite links
items.description: Tick to remove invite links to Discord servers and Telegram or WhatsApp groups.

items.title: Blocked words
items.description: Words or phrases auto-mod removes, separated by commas. End one with * to catch any ending, like scam*.

items.title: Stricter filters
items.description: Tick to also remove shouting in capitals, floods of emoji and huge walls of text. Glitchy stacked-up letters are always removed.

items.title: Turn off the scam shield
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz removing account-stealing links: fake Nitro and Steam gifts, lookalike sites (dlscord, steamcommunlty) and links dressed up as another site. The sender is muted for an hour in case their account was hacked. On while this is unticked.

items.title: Turn off the raid shield
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz watching for raids. When lots of people join at once, newcomers can't post links or mentions and post slowly for 15 minutes, and the team is alerted. On while this is unticked.

items.title: Joins that mean a raid
items.description: How many people joining within one minute raises the raid shield.

items.title: Newcomer link wait (minutes)
items.description: New members can post links after this many minutes (keeps spam bots out). 0 lets them post links right away.

items.title: Warnings before a mute
items.description: Standing warnings that mute someone automatically (1 hour, growing with each warning after). 0 turns it off.

items.title: Warnings before a kick
items.description: Standing warnings that kick someone automatically. 0 turns it off.

items.title: Warnings before a ban
items.description: Standing warnings that ban someone automatically. 0 turns it off.

items.title: Don't notify members about moderation
items.description: Tick to stop Blitz sending members a notification when they're warned, muted, kicked or banned (with the reason, and how to appeal). On while this is unticked.

items.title: Anthropic API key
items.description: Lets Blitz understand and answer messages with Claude. Create a key at console.anthropic.com. Messages that mention Blitz, plus the last few messages in that channel, are sent to Anthropic's API (never from private channels). Leave empty and Blitz still answers common questions (where to post, the rules, levels, reminders…) from what it knows about the community, with no AI.

items.title: About this community
items.description: Optional. A sentence or two for Blitz's brain: what the community is about, its vibe, in-jokes. Only used with an API key.

items.title: Let Blitz's brain help moderate
items.description: Tick to have Claude double-check blocked-word hits in context before removing them (fewer false alarms), sum up reports for the team, catch people up with !tldr, and answer the team's questions in Ask Blitz. Needs the API key. Only messages involved are sent, never from private channels.
